title: Q8_0 up-skip call-limit sweep after full blk.0 top1 failure

bottleneck_component.name: DeepSeek decode CPU up/down fallback plus source/page behavior

candidate.name: Call-limit sweep for Q8_0 CUDA up skip before CPU fallback
candidate.why_this_step: Find where the currently small local Q8_0 up differences begin to flip token-level top1, before any broader layer expansion or benchmark.
candidate.expected_ram_pressure: Same 16GB cgroup as the failed full-blk0 verifier; no new model residency or page-cache policy.
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: Not evaluated in this correctness/root-cause sweep.
candidate.hard_upper_bound: No SOTA can be promoted from this sweep. Even a passing call limit only bounds correctness and does not prove useful token-rate gain.

correctness_gate.baseline_source: Reuse the skip-disabled result.gguf from /root/lfz/runs/vendor-ds4-16gb/20260704T190709Z-q80-up-skip-top1/blk0-up-full-clean after verifying its source head and baseline exit status.
correctness_gate.check: For each max_calls value, run llama-results --check --top1-report with GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_SKIP_NAME_FILTER=blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight and GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_SKIP_MAX_CNE1=1.
correctness_gate.failure_rule: Any failing value is rejected and must not be used for performance claims. Do not expand scope beyond the highest passing value until root cause is understood.

promotion_rule: This sweep cannot be promoted as SOTA. New SOTA requires a later strict cold France run with drop_caches, RAM/page-cache accounting, TTFT gate, correctness, commit/push, and pushed-source reproduction.
